assessment: Kinetochores are large protein complexes that mediate faithful chromosome segregation in eukaryotes. The authors develop an in vitro approach to study interactions between kinetochores and microtubules in yeast cell extracts. They use this powerful lysate-based system to characterize a new role for the budding yeast kinesin-8, Kip3, in powering lateral kinetochore movement along microtubules. This paper should be of interest to researchers working in the field of mitosis, the cell cycle, and the cytoskeleton, and, more broadly, for those studying macromolecular complexes with reconstitution and in vitro imaging approaches.
